productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Horrible Printer - Don't buy. Impossible to setup
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I've tried setting this printer up over Wifi and USB cable. Through my Laptop and my smartphone. No matter what you do it won't recognize or detect the printer. It is unusable.Ridiculous for a Rs. 18,999 Printer. Completely useless.Update: Just to give you an idea, to take scans on this printer, it asks you to enable your location (GPS) on your smartphone, and create an account with HP. You have to wonder why. Throughout the setup, it keeps asking for your location. After over an hour of struggle I managed to set it up on my smartphone, but no matter what I do, my laptop cannot use the HP Smart App to connect to this printer regardless of whether I use the Wifi or USB options. If I try to log into the built in web server on the printer, the password I am expected to provide is wrong. This is so ridiculous - because I am connecting to it over USB!!Don't buy this printer! if you must buy one from HP, by a different model. My 10 year old printer works effortlessly, but this is a piece of junk. I didn't have a great impression of HP, but now its hit a new low.Update: part of the problem is there are limited instructions, and some of it is incorrect. This printer says it supports 5Ghz networks but actually it supports only 2.4Ghz. If you are trying to set it up on a 5Ghz network, it will never detect, and won’t even tell you that is the reason. If setup with the HP app doesn’t work, just use your built in software. Their app isn’t needed except for mobile devices,  and I feel they mainly use it to collect data on you 😞

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Best printer for homes and small businesses
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Great printer. Took 10 minutes to unpack and 5 minutes to set up which only requires plugging it in, connecting to laptop using the USB cable and downloading the driver and scanning software from the HP website. The printer is detected automatically as soon as the driver is installed. Also install the HP Smart app and plugin app on your mobile and follow the instructions to print documents and pictures from mobile to the printer it is connected to your wifi using the printer display panel wizard. Took another 5 minutes to get everything working just fine. Scanning using the ADF or flatbed is a breeze. Go for the ADF model because it allows scanning and printing legal size documents also in addition to the usual A4. Overall an unbeatable printer below Rs 20k. Yet to try out the fax.Update after 8 months continuous use: Working fine even after relocation across the country through packers and movers. Great value for money. Takes just minutes to set up. Retaining the original box and packing is advisable.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Its a Dinosaur - Strong but failes in a few important places
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a GREAT printer, no doubt. However, it miserably fails in a few areas.Cons:1. NOT Hp Eprint enabled => Cannot have an email address for the peinter for remote printing. There is google cloud integration, but useless as google cloud print does not exist anymore.2. Printer web UI- Reminds me of windows 98.3. Max scan resolution is 300dpi.thats bad for many uses.4. Toner - almost 4.8k.Most inportantly NOT AVAILABLE ANYWHERE.5. NO AUTOMATIC DUPLEX PRINTING.PROS:1. ADF is a bliss.2. Gets the job done. Has good print quality.3. Easy to setup and get running.4. Compatible with android wireless print, Windows wireless print, Air print.Bottom Line: Its features ring all the bells. However at this price point, Duplex Printing and hp E Print are a mandate, which are lost here. Disppointed. Will have ot for some time but will eventually get it off of my hands and go for a laser option that has the features.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Best affordable All in one Laser Printer
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very good and affordable laser printer. What I like and don't like about HP MFP 136FNW laser printerGood1. Not too heavy, occupies small space.2. Easy to install and operate. Works well with wireless network (Wi-Fi).3. Print quality and copier works well.4. ADF (Automatic Document Feeder) works really good.Bad (Need Improvement)1. Scanner does not work with Wi-Fi, need to connect to USB every time for scanning of documents.2. Highest scan resolution is just 300 dp, better if it would have been upto 600 dp.3. Refresh at startup takes a little bit time.
Every function is working properly except auto duplex printing. As mentioned in the specifications, auto duplex is not working in HP laser MFP 138fnw. Very disappointed.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Wonderful product from Brother, nice print, no sound while printing and amazing quality.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I purchased this item for home use. I was using HP Desk jet All in One printer and fed up with refilling and changing its cartridge, where it was dry out quickly ; realized it was a wrong item purchased. I gave that item to someone who can manage its cartridge better. This time I was looking for just a printer (no color, no all in one) with wifi support (As I wanted to make sure that I can connect from mobile devices) with auto duplex support and least operating cost. My search ended in monochrome laser printer (black and white) and then picked up Brother brand. I got this printer with discount, so its value for money.Advantages I can see -- Cartridges easily available, cost is less than 2000 and can print upto 3000 pages. This is far better than HP printers in cost wise.- Paper tray will hold paper inside, there is no need to open and put paper for print and its completely closed.- Very nice printout, no sound while printing and very fast.- I can print from Laptop and Mobile.Its Wifi setup was difficult, it took about three hours for me to complete the setup. The reason, the CD that came with this printer wasn't reading, hence I had to download its drivers. Plus wifi setup was bit tricky. After doing initial setup from Laptop print from mobile wasn't coming.Here is the tip, once you have Brand new printer, you can contact Brother support, they will provide installation and demo free of cost. I called Brother support, the support person visited my place and addressed the issue quickly. Print from mobile too work.I've also compared HP laser jetss, they have world's smallest laser printer, but that doesn't support auto duplex (double side printing). That's small, but then there is no covered paper tray, hence you will have to open and manage paper overtime you want prints. None of the laser printers in this price range from HP or Canon supports auto duplex mode.Overall a very good product. If you feel you choose a laser printer with full duplex support; this is the best one low cost. All other laser printer cost higher.

I had a Canon inkjet printer which I'd bought 6 years ago and had an ink tank installed. Turns out inkjet printer cartridges get clogged if you don't use them frequently enough. So the savings from the ink tank against cartridges went back into buying new cartridges. Time for a laser printer, then.Zeroed in on this Brother laser printer now after reading several reviews and watching several youtube videos. Waited a few days to get a good price as the price kept fluctuating every 2 days. Finally bought it for 10,499 - a very good deal, I believe.Been using it for a month and a half and so far, extremely happy with the performance and print quality. Prints are sharp and quick. No smudging, no streaking.Adding it to a new PC is extremely easy. Switch it on and let Windows search for it in "Add a printer" settings. Pairs within seconds. No drivers needed to be installed.Printing wirelessly via the phone app is a bit slow. Printing from a PC is fast though. Haven't measured the print per minute since I need to take 4-5 prints at a time.The wireless & auto-duplex functions were the main attraction for me. I thought about buying one with a scanner, but Microsoft Lens app is a good enough document scanner now.Overall, this printer gets a 5* rating from me.
Good product but toner cost high

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The printer (HP 4826) is nice.1) Printer price is high compared to the HP 2338 series, but makes up in ink cost.2) The colour ink (HP 47) claims 700 pages and costs Rs 475 at the time of writing, whereas most other HP inks costs Rs 800+ but gives only 180 pages! So, in the long run the cost of the printer will be recovered. However HP-47 is a new ink and only used by this printer now, so it may not as easily available as others.3) Can print wirelessly from mobile phone, laptop, desktop as long as they are on the same wired/wireless networkEasy to install.Print quality is acceptable on normal paper, although it looks quite a bit on the lighter side (to save ink/ speed?).If printing from PC, there is option to choose “best” print quality but it becomes really slow.Print alignment sheet comes after first 3 prints, which needs to be scanned for improving quality. Printing speed is average.Photo printing was OK-OK on JK photo paper.There were no clear instructions on the installation, try watching videos online. Here are the steps1) Open box, remove all blue plastic tapes. Open the paper in and out trays, adjust paper width by lifting the backside tab and pushing the width tab. Load few sheets of A4 paper. Insert the power cable.2) Turn on printer. Open cartridge door. Install both ink cartridges3) Install HP-smart app on mobile phone. The blue light on wireless will be blinking (setup mode, this lasts for 2 hours after first power up, so turn-on only when you are planning to install) With printer on and nearby (and within wireless router range) start installation process, follow instructions.4) Wireless network password would be asked, and also you would have to sign up for HP account.5) Try printing from mobile. Once the printer setup is over, the printer can be added on any Windows-10 PC by using ADD-Printer option in control panel. There is no need to install the HP software on PC, but it has some features, so it is recommended.Overall it an OK printer with an average to low speed vs quality, but promises low ink cost. It is aimed at home use only and will not satify a professional.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Insightful Review: HP Deskjet Ink Advantage Ultra 4286 Printer - A Comprehensive Evaluation
productPageReviews.reviewDescription:
The media could not be loaded.
                
            
                
            
            
        
    
    








  
  
    I recently purchased the HP Deskjet Ink Advantage Ultra 4286 Printer, and I'd like to share my thoughts and experiences with this product. Firstly, I want to mention that the printer was delivered promptly by Amazon, and they provided a one-time password for secure delivery, which was commendable.When I opened the box, I noticed some areas were wet due to heavy precipitation during delivery, but thankfully, everything inside was intact and factory sealed. As a long-time user of HP printers, I decided to replace my 8-year-old HP Deskjet 3545 printer, which had cartridge recognition issues despite my troubleshooting efforts.I chose this printer because I needed a dual-band Wi-Fi printer, and this model was the only one officially supported by HP's website, as per my research. However, I must admit that the printer's design is not as compact as I had hoped. Finding a suitable spot for it at my residence proved challenging, and I had to position it precariously due to the location of the paper tray at the back. The printer also feels a bit bulky compared to my previous Deskjet models.Setting up the printer was straightforward, and it seamlessly linked with my HP Smart app account. However, I was disappointed to find that the printer's retro monochrome display only shows the number of prints and cartridge levels, lacking the advanced functionality of its predecessors. Nevertheless, the printer proved to be fast and efficient for my occasional home printing needs.I was pleasantly surprised by the scan speed, which was much faster than I anticipated, even at 300 dpi with the HP Smart app. The printer delivers on its advertised features, allowing for black and white and color copying and printing. However, I must note that the advanced features heavily rely on the HP Smart app, while basic functionalities like color and black-and-white copying can be done manually.Regarding AirPrint, I was provided with four standard presets for print quality: Black and White, Black and White - Draft, Color, and Color - Fine. The black and white preset delivers the standard black and white print quality one would expect.The black and white draft preset is a printer setting for quick and economical printing of black and white documents. It optimizes the printing process for speed and reduces ink usage, resulting in faster print speeds and lower ink consumption. However, the print quality may be slightly lower, with less emphasis on fine details and potentially lighter shades of black. This preset is useful for printing draft versions of documents, where print quality is not a primary concern, and saving ink and time is more important.The color preset produces color prints in full color, including various shades and hues. On the other hand, the color fine preset is designed for higher-quality print and accurate color reproduction. It provides enhanced capabilities to render colors with greater precision and detail, resulting in sharper and more vibrant prints.In the HP Smart app, you won't find the same presets as provided with AirPrint. Instead, the app offers presets like Best, Normal, and Draft, which are self-explanatory for one's printing purposes.I noticed a change from the 3545 printers, as this model lacks a dual-sided print feature. Instead, HP implemented a rear paper tray where you can manually flip the page to print on the other side. While it's not as convenient as an automated option, it still gets the job done.The color print speed is notably faster than its predecessor, especially with the color fine options. HP has made impressive improvements in this area. The print quality of black and color prints on the Best and Normal presets is splendid.The items included in the box were as advertised by the retailer. The retailer's title may have omitted the "DeskJet" name for better clarity, but I was delighted to find that they included 2 sets of cartridges as part of the offer, which exceeded my expectations.Additionally, one notable advantage of the HP Deskjet Ink Advantage Ultra 4286 Printer is its lightweight design. Compared to some bulkier models, this printer is relatively light, making it easier to carry and place in your desired location. This feature adds to the convenience and flexibility of setting up the printer in various spaces within your home or office.Overall, I find the HP Deskjet Ink Advantage Ultra 4286 Printer to be a suitable choice for my occasional home printing needs. However, it's important to note that some core design aspects and advanced functionality have been depreciated compared to its predecessor in the Deskjet series. The printer's compact size, as advertised, was a letdown for me, and I had to position it carefully due to the backside paper tray.I would recommend this printer to those who have similar home printing needs, whether occasional or slightly more frequent. However, if you're looking for a printer with more advanced features and are open to considering ink tank printers, which have affordable ink bottle prices within a feasible budget range, they might be a better option.In conclusion, while the HP Deskjet Ink Advantage Ultra 4286 Printer has its drawbacks in terms of design and some functionality, it serves its purpose well for home users with infrequent printing needs.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: The best printer I ever had
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Since I am an illustrator and designer, I was looking for a printer that could give quality prints of my artwork on vinyl sticker paper and card stock paper.I just got it, and I already put it to the test on vinyl sticker paper, I am going to test it on photo paper and card stock paper next.Setting up the printer was really easy, just follow all the instructions on the manual, it takes 20 minutes to get the ink in the system after filling the tanks for the first time, then you simply go to the website mentioned in the manual to download the installer and set up your printer on the Wi-Fi...easy peasy.Since I am printing at high quality, printing a A4 page of stickers takes a bit of time (still less than a minute), the printer is really silent, you can barely hear it when it prints.The print colors are really vivid and true to the colors displayed on screen on my laptop which is exactly what I was looking for in a printer.This is a printer specifically designed to print photos, which is probably what makes all the difference. For the professional use I am putting it to it's complete value for money. Do not buy if you are looking at a more everyday , document printing type of printer. It's not that you can't print documents, hubby did, it's just that if that it all you will need a printer for, spending extra money on a photo printer won't make much sense.I am using it on a Macbook Pro, so to all those wondering, this printer is compatible with Mac.

If your router doesn't support WPS, printer setup won't be smooth (this printer has no LCD display and supports only 2.5G not 5G). Head alignment and ink check will take nearly 20 mins. Photo print quality is average. Very basic printer bought for INR 27,500.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: A great economical printer for home
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I have been looking for a printer to help my kid with his school assignment during this COVID period. There were several options coming my way, such as epson 3150 and 3152. I decided to go with L805, and believe me, there has never been a day when it disappointed me. I have been using this printer for a month or more now, and below is my feedback:1) The print quality is amazing. I have printed close to 40+ high quality (photoshop, lightroom and snapseed edited) photographs with it.2) The ink tank is proving economical. I am coming from Canon inkjet printer, wherein my cartridge dries after 30 prints but 805, oh boy, the ink levels have dropped only 10% (or even less) for these 40+ prints and several A4 documents3) The printer works on wifi for windows seamlessly, however, you would need epson app to print documents and photographs while operating it from a smartphone/ ipad.  I am still unable to configure it over air print for my ipad and mac.4) Installation and ink filling process is simple. There are several videos and guide available. Infact most of the studios around my house use this printer which helped me decide upon this printer.5) Epson ink (6 bottles) will cost you around 2.5-3k while non branded ones are available for 600. Looking at the performance of ink tank, I find it hard that you will opt for a non branded oneI hope these observations helps you decide. Good luck with the search.Cheers

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 23 February 2025
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I needed to purchase a dependable, inexpensive, Windows 11 compatible, laser printer for home-office. ANY inkjet printer was OUT of the question because of my "low volume" use. I read dozens of reviews on this and MANY other "base-line" laser printers, but when the smoke cleared, at $79, with 600dpi, utilizing standard and size legal paper, low-priced refill cartridges, this "no-frills" Canon® won out. I pulled the trigger.This Canon® LBP6030w™ performed like A CHAMP right out of the box! But while waiting for delivery, I first read all the info on the Canon® website, watched the installation video for Windows, and downloaded the latest software - which installed like a breeze with the printer connected!NOTES:1) I prefer being "hardwired" with a USB cable. Since the printer sits about 3 feet from my PC, I really have no need for wireless printing at home, and we know that a cable is ALWAYS faster! Wireless is still there if I ever decide to switch.2) It comes with a CD containing the installation software. DO NOT INSTALL IT, even though the instructions included in the box tell you to do so. Go to the Canon® website and download and install the latest software version instead - which is a COMPLETE, FULL version - NOT just an "update!" Use the enclosed CD for target practice.3) Most laser printer users are used to having some type of icon and/or user interface to check toner level, contrast, etc. This printer DOES NOT have any user interface. To get the printer's "status", turn the printer on, hold the button (left side) below the power indicator light for 3-4 seconds, and a unit status report will be printed out. Below is a sample.To test it, I printed out my last submitted 46-page inventory report, complete with specialized text, graphs, pie charts, and even a few employee photos. BEAUTIFUL!Since I've only had this printer for about a week, I cannot address dependability, but I have a feeling it will be next to my desk for a LONG TIME.
Good printer, good price

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: The BEST in the value of your money....
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: See i purchased this canon G1010 for home use and it is the best for it. If you really want a single function printer on which you can rely, this is that. See printing differs as you change the mode of printing and canon also gives you free ink bottles to you so actually the printer only costs you between Rs.5500-6000 and the product support is excellent.It may not have the scan and print facility as the all in one printers has but you can use Adobe Scan for a much better AI powered scans. It also have the feature of manual duplex printing. One of the best features I liked in it that you can print via your smartphones also using USB mode in printhand, bolo print or print share like apps....Actually I really liked this printer as it really valued my money....

I think overall a very good product at this price range.The ink consumption is fairly good.The only two minute cons are prints very slow, and some colours are not printed upto the mark even with best quality and paper.But I think this what we get at this range.

PRINT QUALITY IS GOOD. I FEEL THE COLOUR PRINT IS LIGHTER IN CASE OF STANDARD MODE ESPECIALLY THE PINK AND VIOLET THAN WHAT IT IS DISPLAYED IN THE COMPUTER. THAT COULD BE DUE TO THE INK DIFFERNCE. I HAVE USED EPSON L 355, AND SO I COULD COMPARE THE QUALITY OF THE COLOURS. OTHER MOST IMPORTANT FEATURE IS THE REMOVABLE PRINT HEAD-CATRIDGE TYPE , WHICH IN FUTURE WE NEED NOT GO TO A SERVICE CENTRE TO REPLACE IT. WE COULD DO IT OURSELF. REPLACING THE PRINT HEAD OR CLEANING IT IS REALLY CUMBERSOME IN CASE OF EPSON. OVERALL IT IS A FANTSTIC PRODUCT AND VALUE FOR MONEY. EXCELLENT BUY.

Literally the best printer in this range, performance with no hitch. One thing is that, you have to print on frequent intervals, dont let the printer sit. If you let the printer sit, you have to use ink flush. In short, was never stuck with this printer. It works like a charm always.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Huge wastage of ink routinely stops reaching the print head
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The ink in either of the 3 pipes (C,M,Y) periodically stops reaching the print head and that color would stop appearing on color prints, making them discolored due to absence of one color. Then to correct this problem you either call the customer service or yourself run "Ink Flush", either option wastes hell lot of ink. Almost 10-20% of all ink is wasted in one "ink flush" run. Similarly, the customer care representative would also waste similar amount of ink but he would claim that he did his best by using injections and not running ink flush.In my 20 day usage, this problem has already occured twice, wasting almost 30% percent of the color inks. Its such a disappointment.Customer care is of no help as they come and waste your own ink.Regarding print quality and ink consumption on prints, it is fine.

Got it checked and installed by canon person for warranty, he came in 2 days. 1-Oct being holiday. Bangalore.Main purpose is to print kid worksheets and exercises. Since I have pc and laptop, didn’t went for wifi models and saved few thousand. Its simple plug and play, just Download latest driver from canon site and its good to go.On purchasing printer I bought extra inks for 423/- per bottle. ( it comes with ink)Print quality is good quality, b/w and color both. Took couple of them.Don’t need scanner, I use Microsoft office lens app for scanning documents/cards. iPhone camera is better 🙂I got better deal on amazon then Offline stores 9100 (printer + additional 1black, 3 colour ink) + saved time
All best
Printer material is good and prints are in satisfaction.Coming to photo print it is like a lab print.vallue for money.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good printer. But no AirPrint support.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The printer is easy to configure and use. Has decent signal reception in the room I have kept this, away from the wifi router which is in another room. For comparison, my iphone does not receive signals from this area.I have been using this printer for more than 7 months and the experience has been really good. It gives your professional prints. It came with two bottles of ink and despite several prints, the first bottle is showing no signs of wearing out.The printer is compact and can easily be accommodated into a cupboard. Check the dimensions to decide where to place this conveniently in your home or office.Once the wifi is configured, it connects to the network in a few seconds every time it is turned on. The indicators are also well placed and gives accurate information on the network connectivity and paper loading.I have kept the printer idle for long periods of time and have not observed any sort of issues after this period of inactivity. No printer ink issues or any general issues.The biggest drawback of this printer is that it doesn't support Apple Airprint (although the seller listing says so). This will not allow you to print directly from your iPhone and iPad. For this purpose, I am using a Mac application by the name HandyPrint. Once you install that on your Mac and turn the Mac on, your iPhone and iPad will detect the printer if all of them are on the same wifi network. Then you can print it.Another issue I found is that the default software CD that came along with the printer did not work well in installing the driver. So I had to manually download the driver from the internet. Once that is done, your Mac will automatically detect further updates to the driver.I am rating the printer at 4 for its excellent design, hasslefree operation, and savings it offers. The only concern is about the lack of AirPrint support which would have easily tempted me to give it a 5.

Product Description
Thermal Shipping Label Printer - Frees Up Your Time and Convenient Your Daily Life. 
USB Disk Installation Driver 
Desktop thermal label printer is equipped with a USB disk, which contains the installation printer driver, DIY edit label software, can help you set the printer.

Desktop Barcode Printer - Small Size and Huge Energy. 
Concise Fashion 
Built-in dual induction positioning function, the label printer can automatic paper detection and positioning, and automatically adjust the position accurately, automatic paper identification, making the entire printing process convenient and quick. 
Portable Size 
Label printer for shipping packages has a small size, which only 8.74''x4.01''x3.77'', so it can save your desk space. Besides, it can print all size direct thermal labels. (Up to 4''x6'') 
Place Two Paper Labels

Product Specification 
Printing Method 	Direct Thermal 	
Printing Resolution 	203 dpi 	
Printing Speed Maximum 	180 mm/s 	
Size 	222x102 x 96mm 	
Compatible System 	Windows/Linux/Mac 	
Label Width Range 	From 1.5" to 4.65" (38mm-118mm) 	
Compatible Platform 	All major shipping platforms and marketplaces 	
Install Mode 	One step install with USB flash drive 	
Wide Application Areas 
Thermal Label Printer works as a regular printer that can print bar codes, texts, image or graphics, print anything you send to printer from windows’ and Mac’s devices. label printer addresses the rapidly increasing demands of logistics and express, E-commerce,warehouse, retail market and more. Provides quickly and high quality print, cost-effective, durable and reliable Thermal Label Printer. Designed to get you easy and efficient print, saves you both time and money when you are using it. 
Label Applications 
Bar-code labels, 4”x 6” shipping labels, address labels, postage labels, Amazon labels, commodity labels, warehouse labels, carton labels, ID labels, bulk mailing labels, multipurpose labels and more. 
No Toner No Ink 
Thermal technology, works with any direct thermal labels. No printer ink or toner needed. Make you an incredible low print cost. 
Print Multiple Size of Labels 
Prints labels from 1.57'' to 4.1'' in width and height from 1.25'' to 9.84'' including 4''x 6''/4''x 4''/4"x 3"/4''x 2''/3''x 2''/2.25''x 1.25'' main labels. 
Roll and Fan-fold Labels 
Supports roll or fan-fold labels loaded from back of the printer, better use with label holder especially for roll label papers. 
Making Label Printing Efficient 
Automatic label identification, no waste first label. Press and hold the top circular paper feeder button until you hear one beep and then release. It will automatically detect the size and characteristics of your label. 
Package contents. 
1 x printer/1 x usb cable/1 x power supply/1 x manual user/1 X USB Disk/1 x label holder 
How to download and set up driver for Windows/MacBook? 
Windows: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Windows driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software (PrinterDriverInstall_V1.01) to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
MacBook: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Mac driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software (LabelPrinterDriverInstaller_ForMac_V1.0) to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
Why the printer print extra blank labels after the one successful print? 
Please check if the paper size setting of the printer is correct and adjust the scale and margins in preview page or page setup. 
I installed the printer driver. Why am I still unable to print? 
(1) The printer needs to be powered on and connected to the computer prior to installing the driver. Please uninstall the driver and try to reinstallation. 
(2) The print port is occupied. Please go to the “Printer properties” of your computer and change a different USB port. 
Operation: Device and Printer→Printer Properties→Port→Select other USB port(USB001~USB005). 
(3) You have not successfully installed the driver. Please reinstall the corresponding operating system driver in the U disk.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Worth it - If it keeps, even half of what it promises. In Theory - Good concept & Peace of mind.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: A PREVIEW TO PURCHASE:*********************************I recently bought a canon printer worth 11000 from amazon which had a 1 year manufacturer’s warranty attached to it ,as is the case with most of the electronic devices.Now since, I was sure in my plans, to use the printer for a couple of years before even thinking of buying another one , I felt the dire need  to secure the device warranty a bit further .This is where the extended warranty plans like onsitego claim , to offer help for a nominal charge. As expected the offered assurance was highly compulsive and hard to resist .Thus I bought an extended 2 year warranty plan for printer and scanners for 799 bucks.ABOUT THE BRAND ONSITEGO :****************************************From all I could gather from the internet, the onsitego or Onsite Electro Services Private limited is a recent  start & brainchild of three young entrepreneurs , alumnus from premier institutes like IITs and IIMs led by Mr. Kunal Mahipal (CEO), Rahul Rai (CTO) & Sunil gandhe (COO).It is sponsored by Accel which is a leading, early and growth-stage venture capital firm, powering a global community of entrepreneurs.The site setup works to provide Extended Warranty and damage protection for your electronic devices like laptop, mobiles, hard disks, printers, televisions, gaming consoles, AC, refrigerator, audio systems etc. to protect your devices even after the expiry of your manufacturer’s warranty.Presently onsitego has its partnership with most of the major online e-commerce portals like flipkart.amazon,croma,snapdeal and vijay sales.ABOUT THE PRODUCT :*******************************I have just registered the product for warranty and haven’t had any real need for claims yet, hence except the claim settlement experience , I would describe in detail about the offered features:1.) This extended warranty can be availed on a variety of electronics products and small appliances for products :a.) Purchased only in india .For items purchased abroad it is not applicable.b.) The onsitego extension can be purchased for any eligible product bought within 6 months.c.) Product must have a valid OEM warranty of minimum 1 years for additional onsitego extension.d.) As per guidelines, You can cancel the policy anytime and payment will be reversed within 30 days provided you haven’t made any claims.2.) The onsitego replicates manufacturer’s warranty up to additional 4 years covering any appliance up to maximum of 5 years.For instance, if a product has 2 years of manufacturer’s warranty then onsitego can provide additional maximum of 3 years to make the product secure for 5 years.++ For mobiles ,smart watches and tablets however, it offers only one year additional warranty to manufacturer’s term.3.) The program claims to offer complete cashless service covering all labour , transportation or repair charges.+ Additionally all the spare parts replaced are guaranteed to be genuine.4.) The site also claims to free pick up or on site repair of device with just site register of the issue without the need of directly interacting with the service centres.+ You can get the device repaired on your own too provided you keep the onsitego informed.+ Also there is no limit to the number of repairs for a device with extended warranty.5.) The site also claims paperless & hassle free register of service requests by just providing the invoice receipt of the product with the device IMEI or serial number.6.) Finally , Onesitego offers a service assurance program for all its customers under which , If the onsitego fails to repair your product within quoted timeline, It will either offer a gift card for purchase of a new device as per the latest price of the product or offer an equivalent specification - New or refurbished device.FINAL VERDICT :**********************On paper and in concept , all the features and services provided seem to be quite good ( in fact too good to be practically true ) but even if it full fills half of what it promises , I suppose we have a deal at hand.I haven’t had any first-hand experience of their services until now but on the contrary , I haven’t had any good experience with direct manufacturers either , even after having premium products with premium fast track customer care options.So in theory , it may be seen as a peace of mind to make up for the insecurity of repairs & sudden component failures  in electronic gadgets.I would suggest, buying appliances in sales and putting some of the money saved into such insurance programs. The perspective though, is my own personal & may vary from person to person.I will surely update if I come across their services.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great printing quality and easy to use
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I treated myself to this printer recently as I am constantly printing photos for arts and craft projects and scrapbooking and wanted a printer that could give my quality and durable colours.The printer is lightweight and truely compact, once the paper cassette and dust covers are off, everything fits nicely in a small drawer. It is also very user friendly as far as printing goes.My only real big issue with it, is that my Mac OS is not covered, so even if I get the USB cable (not included in the box) it would not be compatible. Canon is apparently known to not update their drivers frequently.Another thing that would have been an added advantage would be printing via Wi-Fi, this feature which was present on th CP910 is not available on the CP1000 (sadly the cp910 is not available in India with a local warranty).You can easily print by transferring your pictures to a USB drive or an SD card still. And of course, via USB cable straight from your computer if your OS is covered by the driver.One small glitch you need to be aware of when printing pictures : if you edit your pictures in Photoshop first, you may end up having the printer not recognise them as a valid JPEG file. I ran into that issue myself but it is EASILY fixable if you just remember to save your pictures in Photoshop opting for the "Baseline (standard)" mode instead of the default "Optimized".Apart from the fact the USB cable is not included, there is also NO CARTRIDGE coming with the printer. You need to buy it separately. I read that a started kit cartridge comes with other models abroad, but the CP1000, at least in India is not coming with anything. I ordered both the printer and the cartridge on the same day on Amazon, the cartridge took one extra day to come. So when my printer arrived, I had to rein in my impatience to use it and wait for my cartridge and paper set to be delivered.And yes, again, in our time and age, it would have been great to have the wi-fi option on that printer. It existed on the previous model they launched, not sure why they decided to scrap it off this version, this doesn't make a lot of sense.
Nice printer. Happyy with it. Print bordered ones if you think your photo is a bit large. Otherwise it gets cut srom all the sides. Otherwise a great fun printer for family pictures.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Canon CanoScan LiDE 400: 実用的だが期待以上の進化は見られず
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: この製品、Canon CanoScan LiDE 400を購入し、全体的に非常に堅実なスキャナーだと感じています。製品自体の品質もしっかりしており、日常のスキャン用途には十分応えてくれます。特にそのスリムなデザインは、デスク上のスペースを節約できる点で非常に便利です。ただし、特別優れているという印象は受けませんでした。少し背景を説明すると、以前はCanoScan LiDE 200を使用していました。この200で特定の写真を高品質でスキャンしようとした際、あまり満足のいく結果が得られませんでした。新しいスキャナーが必要かどうか悩みましたが、最終的にLiDE 400を購入しました。新しいLiDE 400で同じ写真をスキャンしたところ、速度は少し向上したものの、結果的に画質は旧モデルと大差ありませんでした。確かに動作はスムーズになり、わずかな改善が見られましたが、期待していたほどの目に見える改善はありませんでした。10〜15年前の製品と比べて、ハードウェア面での進化はあまり感じられないというのが正直な感想です。唯一の大きな違いは、LiDE 400が最新のソフトウェアやオペレーティングシステムに対応しており、古いスキャナーでは発生する可能性のあるドライバの互換性問題が解消されている点です。これにより、互換性の問題を気にすることなく使用できるのは、非常に大きなメリットです。まとめると、Canon CanoScan LiDE 400は確かに使いやすく、品質も堅実です。しかし、もしすでに旧型のスキャナーをお持ちで、特にソフトウェアの互換性に問題がなければ、無理に買い替える必要はないかもしれません。新しい機能を求める方には良い選択肢ですが、大きな技術的進化は期待しない方が良いでしょう。

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Cercavo una multifunzione laser low budget per stampa documenti e scansioni a casa, senza aspettarmi troppo, ma sono rimasto piacevolmente sorpreso. I materiali sono di buona qualità e pare solida quanto macchine di fascia superiore, ho avuto tante laser negli anni, e altre ne ho usate negli uffici, di tutte le marche, conosco bene queste macchine e non pensavo che a questo prezzo il prodotto offrisse davvero così tanto.L'installazione su Windows 10 è stata semplicissima, l'ho collegata via cavo alla rete ethernet, ho scaricato il software dal sito Xerox andando direttamente a cercarlo, e in un colpo solo, ma veramente in 2 minuti, era già tutto funzionante, inclusa stampa fronte/retro automatico e scanner con tutte le funzioni offerte dal software della casa, molto chiaro, facilmente personalizzabile e anche con una bella interfaccia colorata.Le pagine posizionate nell'alimentatore documenti originali vengono riconosciute senza un segnale acustico e lette al posto del vetro piano, quando presenti, anche con una discreta velocità, specie le scansioni in b/n. La scansione non è ovviamente in fronte/retro con in modelli più grossi, ma questo sarebbe stato impossibile aspettarselo a questo prezzo, così come manca una porta usb per la chiavetta, cosa che avevo sulla precedente ma che non ho mai dovuto usare.Anche il piccolo display LCD è bene illuminato, si può inclinare un poco verso l'alto per praticità, ma grazie al software è talmente comodo fare tutto da pc che credo non lo userò mai, se non per le fotocopie.La stampa è molto veloce, impiega una manciata di secondi la trasmissione del file in rete, ma appena partita è veramente fulminea, una pagina ogni 2 secondi, una velocità non lontana da quella delle grosse stampanti da ufficio.La qualità di stampa è buona, sulle velature grigie si vede qualche lieve imperfezione, non è chiaramente indicata per la grafica, ma questo bisogna aspettarselo da una laser b/n.Non ho provato il wifi ma viene chiesto di configurarlo al primo avvio e si può fare anche in seguito, chiaramente il cavo di rete è sempre più stabile e affidabile su ogni tipo di stampante, quando si può consiglio di installarla con quest'ultimo.Per ora non posso davvero trovarle un difetto.
Le gros carton est arrivé sans dommage.L'imprimante est très bien emballée.Après mise en place des accessoires => fonctionne tout de suite.Qualité d'impression => très bonne.
Funciona muy bien

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Forza Horizon 3 is absolutely fantastic, it proves to be the pinnacle of arcade racing and racing games in general.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Forza Horizon 3 caught my attention from the moment it was announced.I've been playing Forza since it's first release on the Original Xbox and it become my racing game of choice. That said, I've always enjoyed more arcade-y, do whatever you want racers. When I saw the first Forza Horizon, I was very excited, though I ended up missing it. Forza Horizon 2 though, really caught my eye. The beautiful and huge open world amalgamation of France, Italy and Spain, combined with Forza's stunningly crafted cars and handling made Horizon 2 a blast!So of course, when I saw Horizon 3, I knew I had to have it. Where the Forza Motorsports half of the series signature is hyper detailed tracks, cars and simulation handling; The Forza Horizon half of the series has really been building their reputation for bringing you to breath taking locales to explore in beautiful cars while bringing that festival energy to the game. Forza Horizon 2 really did this well, but I have to admit, Forza Horizon 3 has hit it out of the park.Forza Horizon 3 is the first full next gen title in the series. By that I mean Forza Horizon 2 was developed partially on the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One. My point is, it shows. Horizon 3 has amazing vistas, from flying along the beach watching the beautiful sky in a Lamborghini, ripping through the city in a Viper, sliding along the valleys and hills of farmland in a Ford Raptor, monster trucking in rally trucks through the jungle and leaping over red desert mounds in the buggies, you get to rip across all kinds of landscapes in any vehicle you want. It all looks fantastic, there is plenty to see and do in Australia.These are all improvements on the formula of first two Forza Horizons, but what's new? Well, this time around you get to choose from various(limited) player models to appear in your car and an alias for your number 1 to refer to you as throughout the game. Oh and you are the boss of the Horizon Festival, this is a major change to the formula. In this case, you get the choice to modify each championship via what cars that can be driven, the time of day, rain or sunshine and name it. This is a cool feature I enjoyed as you don't have to worry about getting stuck racing C grade hatchbacks, I dunno, that was always boring to me.While it's a cool feature, I did feel like it didn't make as big an impact as I'd hoped story wise, but experience wise, it does make it a lot more fun to choose your own races. Or you can just go with the options presented as well. You also get to choose how your festivals grow. You can choose what regions to expand too and upgrade each festival. It's cool to unlock more races and see visible upgrades to the festival Zone.There are now 'street races' that you can participate in to build up to Midnight Battles, basically a one on one race for slips. It's pretty fun. I will say, when choosing Extreme Off Road races, I didn't feel like the race tracks were designed quite as well as I'd hoped, to utilize to rugged terrain.All in the, the base game is fantastic. The cars look great, the weather and rain is a great edition and looks fantastic. Land is filled with beautiful vistas to see and roads and areas to explore. The cars also definitely all feel and drive differently as well. One of my only dislikes is that in Horizon 2 you got to see and drive around with the festival boss and they interesting conversations. The festival mechanic was also in some cut scenes that were neat. While you hear your number 1 a lot, you never see her. You also only get to see the back of your mechanic who helps you with barn finds, I feel like it takes from their character and from it feeling like a general interactions.Going to the expansions, Blizzard Mountain and Hot Wheels, they are both great additions. Blizzard Mountain features snow for the first time in the whole Forza series and its very impressive. Seeing your tires leave imprints in the snow is satisfying and of course all the challenges of handling in that terrain. The area is nice to look at as well.Maybe one of the biggest changes the expansion introduces is a new system to how you score on races. A 3 star system is introduced and besides winning the race, there are two other objectives to complete during the races. Say you win the race, but to get the other two stars in that particular race you must drift into 20 poles and also reach 120 MPH during the race. These accumulative stars unlock more races, so completing the secondary objectives in the race becomes crucial.It's sort of a nice changes up for the game play, though I feel like it was done better in the expansion following it. I found Blizzard Mountain difficult enough with out the added game play mechanic. Blizzard Mountain is definitely the hardest section on Horizon 3.The Hot Wheels expansion really takes the arcade racing genre to a new level. The tracks are absolutely mind bending and racing on them is always exciting. While you would think that Hot Wheels tracks could never be graphically impressive, Playground Games has definitely proven that wrong. Each track piece has grooves running through them and the massive posts and metal that connects them is jaw dropping when viewed from a distance. When the track has the sun directly behind it, whether blue or orange, it glows through the plastic track impressively. At night, there are either lights on small posts or embedded in the wall of the track to light the way.Meanwhile the islands that are conjoined by the tracks and the beautiful water below all look great. The only thing downside I found to it, is I didn't feel the cities were lively enough. There's two parts of the Expansion that should have people partying, one of which is a large island with skyscrapers. The island with Skyscrapers basically has no one there visible. Besides the amazing loop de loop, twisting and turning tracks, you also get Animatronic dinosaurs blotting the islands and a few cool Hot Wheels cars to race with. It is a Gem and personally I think it could have been a game all to itself.I was able to purchase the base game from Amazon for about $35 brand new during a sale. I also bought the car pass and expansion pass at discounted prices as well on Xbox Live with the Gold Membership. Forza Horizon 3 is absolutely fantastic, it proves to be the pinnacle of arcade racing and racing in general. From highly customizable and upgrade-able beautifully detailed cars, to the amazing vistas and varied races on changing land, this game has almost everything you need to have a great game. It is a must own Xbox exclusive and must own racing game.
Buen juego. Llegó bien y en tiempo

After using Pantum M6518NW🖨️🖨️ Series.... I can say that it comes in budget or better than printers like HP, Canon. Very dissapointed with both the printer and AmazonOn opening the package, i could see the packaging thermocols were already brokenThankfully, the printer was undamagedBut, to my shock, i realised that they sent an old and used model.No original sticky tabs were presentThe cartridge had no protective covering/tab to take out before installing as mentioned in their manual/video..It was not only pre installed, the chip has multiple scratch marks on it, the inside of the printer had toner powder here and there even before first print..You could easily tell it was not a new cartridge at allAnd on the first test print, as expected, there were smudges all over along with lines here and there..On calling their customer service earlier for some other details, they have no idea about technical specifications and they ask you to contact their WhatsApp number who give no replies at all..so it is probably the worst customer service you'll get( or not get)So this printer is not only bound to run into problems, you will never get any kind of support either..The spare parts are not available either properly..The cd they sent is all scratched up and doesn't run..Driver has to be downloaded..The program interface is not very intuitive or user friendly either..not very customisable..only a few prefixed options are available..Copy quality is average with no option to increase the quality.Scan quality is decent though..Looks are good, print is fast enough, lightweight ( read cheap parts, non durable, plastic feels it can break with slightest strain)Affordable yes, but quality and support is non existant..Definitely do not buyAnd do not buy from this seller either, as he is sending used products and refurbished ones and trying to sell as new..Unfortunately, i have to complain about Amazon too in this case..Even though i am trying to initiate return on first day, earlier they had hassle free returns policy, but now you have to mandatorily send pics, contact their representative which takes an average of 5 mins over phone..and then when you send the pics, they tell they have not recieved the pictures (multiple times) and essentially the problem is not solved and return not even initiated..So do not buy this product from this seller or Amazon..DO NOT buy pantum printers at all..2 stars ( one star for the potential of decent prints with a proper cartridge..but it probably can't be refilled easily/ maintain quality)So in the long run, not cheap either..Better to go for brother/HPfor inkjet, canon is best..

Product Description
LENVII Thermal Label Printer Shipping Label Printer-Compate with Windows & Mac and All Major Shipping Platforms and Marketplaces

High-Speed Printing,Printing 72 labels of 4x6 size per minute, the thermal printer supports up to 6IPS high-speed printing with low noise,saved so much time! 
Easy to Start,By downloading the driver from our U Disk , the installation of the label printer could be finished quickly. Shipping Label Printing Guide to help you set up the printer. 
Auto Label Detection,With the intelligent function of adjusting paper, thermal label printer could adjust the position automatically and precisely, making the process go smoothly.

Dual media sensors ensure the shipping thermal label printer accurately positioned when printing.When loading paper, the printing side must face up, and the printer can automatically adjust the paper position.

High-Speed Printing 
Printing 72 labels of 4x6 size per minute,saved so much time!With a resolution of 203dpi, crystal clear images and easy-to-read barcodes printed. 
Thermal label paper slot 
Media sensors ensure the shipping thermal label printer accurately positioned when printing.When loading paper, the printing side must face up, and the printer can automatically adjust the paper position. 
Easy to Open 
Turning the both-side switch button with you can easily open the inside of the printer. Then, you can manually adjust the paper position or clean the thermal print head. 
Compatible with Multiple Label Sizes 
Label printer supports different sizes of label papers,Great for shipping labels, warehouse labels, barcode labels, Amazon labels, product labels, address labels, ID labels, and more .support in width between 48-108mm. 
USB Disk Installation Driver 
Easy to use and set up,Desktop thermal label printer is equipped with a USB disk, which contains the installation printer driver, DIY edit label software, can help you set the printer. 
Packing List 
1*Label printer 
1*User Manuals 
1*USB disk 
1*External label holder 
1*Power adapter 
1*USB cable 
Product Specification 
Printing Method 	Direct Thermal 	
Printing Resolution 	203 dpi 	
Printing Speed Maximum 	150mm/s 	
Printing Width 	48-108mm 	
Compatible System 	Windows/Mac 	
Compatible Platform 	USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Shopify, PayPal, Shipstation Stamps.com etc. 	
Install Mode 	One step install with USB flash drive 	
Print Head Life 	50 km 	
Wide Application Areas 
Thermal Label Printer works as a regular printer that can print bar codes, texts, image or graphics, print anything you send to printer from windows’ and Mac’s devices. label printer addresses the rapidly increasing demands of logistics and express, E-commerce,warehouse, retail market and more. Provides quickly and high quality print, cost-effective, durable and reliable Thermal Label Printer. Designed to get you easy and efficient print, saves you both time and money when you are using it. 
Label Applications 
Bar-code labels, 4”x 6” shipping labels, address labels, postage labels, Amazon labels, commodity labels, warehouse labels, carton labels, ID labels, bulk mailing labels, multipurpose labels and more. 
No Toner No Ink 
Thermal technology, works with any direct thermal labels. No printer ink or toner needed. Make you an incredible low print cost. 
Print Multiple Size of Labels 
Prints labels from 1.57'' to 4.1'' in width and height from 1'' to 9.84'' including 4''x 6''/4''x 4''/4"x 3"/4''x 2''/4''x 1''/3''x 2''/2.25''x 1.25''/2''x 1'' main labels. 
Roll and Fan-fold Labels 
Supports roll or fan-fold labels loaded from back of the printer, better use with label holder especially for roll label papers. 
Making Label Printing Efficient 
Automatic label identification, no waste first label. Press and hold the top circular paper feeder button until you hear one beep and then release. It will automatically detect the size and characteristics of your label. 
How to download and set up driver for Windows/MacBook? 
Windows: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Windows driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
MacBook: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Mac driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
(Please view the installation demonstration video on the USB drive before installation) 
Why does the test print only print out blank pages when the printer driver is successfully installed? 
1）Please check if the paper size setting of the printer is correct and adjust the scale and margins in preview page or page setup. 
2）Please check if the label sticker purchased is a thermal label sticker, the printer only supports printing thermal labels, no ink or toner or ribbon needed. 
(Check the label sticker method: please place the label paper in the printer, turn off the power, finger press the top button of the printer without releasing, turn on the power, wait for 2 seconds, finger release the top button, then the printer will automatically print the test page, such as normal print content, the label paper is thermal label paper. If there is no printed content, please replace the thermal label stickers) 
3）Please make sure your labels are properly loaded. The printing side is facing up. 
I installed the printer driver. Why am I still unable to print? 
(1) The printer needs to be powered on and connected to the computer prior to installing the driver. Please uninstall the driver and try to reinstallation. 
(2) The print port is occupied. Please go to the “Printer properties” of your computer and change a different USB port. 
Operation: Device and Printer→Printer Properties→Port→Select other USB port(USB001~USB005). 
(3) You have not successfully installed the driver. Please reinstall the corresponding operating system driver in the U disk. 
How to solve the problem of installing the installation operation? 
If you encounter problems in the installation / use process, we can provide you with remote service support.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 30 January 2025
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought this printer because I had an older version for over 10 years.  I use it in our small business.  The printer works great.

I'm very happy with this printer.Before I bought it, was looking for a printer that could print alot of pages at a low price and not breakdown. I don't believe anything out there on the market can beat this printer on those objectives.I bought the two year extra warranty just in case if it needs a large repair, however I doubt I will need it. It was only $20 and they pay for shipping and all the repair costs. However, for a minor repair I will take it to my local printer repair shop since I need to use it everyday.I have to add some important info about the printer. It said the yield for the DR280 drum unit is 30,000. So I assumed that's how much pages my new Brother will print. Actually, that's just the drum unit yield, not the toner yield. Like every printer on the market, your first toner will have a low yield. Mine yielded about 3300 pages. It was then that I realized that the drum unit and toner are two different parts with separate yield. The great thing about this printer is that it takes high capacity cartridges which yield 8000 pages.
Brother printer always works well for a small business. It's a great monochrome printer and it never jams even after 2 years.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 11 June 2020
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Printing on pre-printed pressure senstive label templates - ExcellentPrinting on 3" x 7" glossy pressure sensitive labels - ExcellentPrinting from DOS programs - ExcellentI am using both the USB and parallel port, connecting two computers to the one printer.  Real fine.Bypass tray holds about 25 of my thick label templates, so probably 50 pieces of plain paper.  FYI - paper in the bypass tray needs to be put in face up, head in or head left. And it prints from the top of the stack.If I ever need another printer, I will certainly buy this again.Update: Printer continues to work real well.  Probably 200 pages per day on average.  No toner bleed issues, very few jams ( mostly my fault).  Some people have mentioned the noise level.  This is not an issue for me, and if it was I would use the quiet mode.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Good quality printer.  Can’t beat the price.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I waited more than 3 weeks for the printer to arrive but it finally got here.  The setup process on my MacBook Pro took less than two minutes.  The USB cable was not supplied.  It comes with some old out dated cable from 1992.  Im so glad I had the cable to make this printer work immediately after receiving it. Print quality is good, especially for the price. However, it does bleed some black toner on the papers but I’m guessing this will eventually stop.  Not a major concern.  I really like the auto duplex mode allowing to print on both sides automatically.  I bought this printer to replace my old Samsung colour laser printer.  Hopefully this printer will last me years without major issues.

Yes, the Bluetooth printer supports printing thermal label paper/thermal receipt paper.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Userfriendly, Cost effective and good quality printer
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is awsome printer at the given price. Buy this only if you have print usage more than 300 pages a month. Heavy home usage or small office usage is perfect for this printer. I am now using it for more than 10 days and below is my observations.1. Amazing timely delivery of the product, it reached to me before time.2. Easy installation, I installed it by myself without any external help though canon provides free installation of this product.3. Wireless printing and mobile printing is the best option which this printer provides. Hastle free printing.4. Installation of cartridges and ink into ink tank is also easy and user friendly. You can refer to installation and setup video available at amazon and youtube.5. Print quality of both B&W and colour print is awsome, I even tried printing photos on printing paper and the quality is as good as of studio.6. This printer is cost effective due to ink tank facility and like other printers we dont need to replace cartridges every time.Overall a good quality printer with quite fine print quality upto canon standards, cost effective and easy to operate.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Print quality is value for money
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Good product. Value for money.This is my Third review after running the printer for four months.The product is very good compared to laser printers as the quality of print is very  upfront in this range of price.After firmware update which was automatic the product is responding somewhat weirdly though but no compromise in print quality or quantity. Had printed more than 3000 pages up to now in full quality hope it will give much more. The best option of the printer is that it runs independent of any laptop. Direct xerox, scan, color xerox, mobile print are to name a few. It is a good product for home office or small office. During the lockdown it worked like feathers.

I earlier had Canon Pixma MX347 printer which was mediocre but still went for Canon, giving benefit of doubt. The print quality is so-s0, attached. Some streaks are visible but not a deal breaker.The setup is not so user friendly but works once done. There was a very small paper stuck in my printer (showing paper jam error for days) which Canon service guy fixed for free as the printer was under warranty. I initially thought this was sensor malfunction but it seems there was an almost invisible paper piece stuck which needed expert eyes.Overall a good purchase. Would recommend!

Proper delivery from Amazon. Canon G4010 is fit for small business people. I've installed by myself. Easy to do that.1) Build quality is good.2) Print quality is good. (in normal mode average output only, in high mode output is good).3) Quick booting for scan, print & xerox.4) Ink is valuable.5) Feeder helps for FS sheet.6) Wifi works good.1) Paper tray must in-build to storage minimum 50 sheets. Each time using rear tray is uncomfortable to handle.2) Scanning place (Glass) must have FS size. Bcoz some documents not in quality bring by customer and we are unable to scan. The paper is stock in the feeder. If you offering FS size default, kindly provide scanning glass also the same size.Overall, Canon G4010 is good for business.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 13 June 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Not Plug and Play, but good value if you are somewhat technical
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: TL;DR: Requires a bit of setup but works great, I’m shocked at the value. This is probably best budget but feature packed laser printer you can get right now (wireless laser printer with auto duplex printing).This printer cost about $80--in contrast to the Brother HL-L2370 printer which has the same feature set but is double the cost at $160 (though that one has Airprint so you'd probably have an easier time setting up). The Brother HL-L2320D at $120 only has auto duplexing (no wireless connectivity) and the Brother HL-L2305 at $120 has wifi connectivity but no auto duplexing.Note that for the initial wireless setup, you will need to use the included USB A cable (yes, you need to plug it into a computer that can use the tool--Windows or Mac), so if you only have a laptop with only USB C ports, you’ll need an adapter (female USB A to male USB C)!From a high level:- You need to connect the printer via USB A to a computer that can run the wireless configuration tool- Run the wireless configuration tool with your computer and use the tool to connect your printer wirelessly to your router- Unplug the USB A cable connecting your computer to the printer- Install the printer drivers, and configure your computer to connect to your printer wirelesslyIf you've been frustrated with the setup for this printer, I don't blame you--the setup is comically bad.To setup wireless printing you first need to connect your printer to power—but before that, make sure you remove ALL the bits on the inside. There’s a styrofoam piece and several orange plastic bits. Pulling out one of the small orange plastic bits on the toner cartridge will also pull out a long plastic sticker (I’m assuming for sealing the toner).Note that these instructions for are the Mac setup, I'd imagine the Windows setup will be easier.Once its ready to go and powered on, go navigate to the canon website and look up Canon LBP6230dw:- Click the 'Support' button- Click 'Software & Drivers'- Select your OS (I have Ventura which is v13)- Download MF/LBP Network Setup Tool Ver.2.33 (OS X 10.9.5 - macOS 13.3.1)- Plugin in the USB cable from the printer to your device- Run the tool, follow the instructions- Select "Wireless LAN Connection"- Select "Yes, I want to configure network settings"- Select "Easy setup"- Select "My wireless LAN access point doesn't have a WPS button".  (Even if your router *does* have WPS functionality, you should turn that off because its junk and a security risk :P)- It will have instructions to plugin the cable, read them if needed but this should be straight forward or already done- Click continue, it should return a list of wireless networks; including your own. If it is hanging (stuck) on a loading animation, right click the printer icon on your bottom dock and click quit and the list should show up if its stuck--(this did the trick for me, I don't know why).- Select your wireless network, type in the WiFi password and continue- It will try to connect and when it does, the prompt will update and a blue light will shine on your printer- If you have a smart router such as an EERO like myself, you will get an alert saying a new device "AzureWave Technology" connected to your router. This is important--use the EERO app on your phone to get the IP Address of your printer since we will use this to connect to it. I also renamed the device to Canon Printer for sanity purposes.- If you don't have a smart router, navigate to your router gateway page and determine the IP Address (the host name should start with Canon). I can't provide specific instructions about this because each router is different.Next step, install the printer drivers on your computer- Use the same page you used to install the wireless configuration tool- UFRII LT Printer Driver Ver.1.5.11 (macOS 10.12.6 - macOS 13.3.1)- Run and follow instructions of the installerAfter installing the drivers:- Open System Settings- Scroll on the left side menu to 'Printers & Scanners'- Select Add Printer, Scanner blahblah- If you see a 'Canon LBP6230dw' with kind 'Bonjour', you're in luck, you can select that, hit "Add" and you're good to go--no other work needed.- If not, its okay, select the 'Globe' icon up top of the add printer menu- In the Address Box: Add your IP Address of your printer (discussed in earlier instructions)- In the Protocol Box: Select Line Printer Daemon - LPD (this is the only option that works with Mac--I tried them all for you)- In the Queue box: this is just the name of your print queue; I just called mine "Canon Laser Printer"- In the Name box: this is the name of your printer; I just called mine "Canon Laser Printer"--this is the name you see in a printer list- Location: Just for your info (mine's on the top of my dresser).- Use: these are the drivers used with the printer, select 'Canon LBP6230/6240'- Select 'Add' and you should be good to goIf it doesn't work:- Either the IP address provided is incorrect- Printer and computer aren't on the same network- Didn't install the drivers.Big props to Cannon for updating the drivers in 2023--I saw some reviews from 2015!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 27 January 2020
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: A fast, cheap monochrome laser. It works well with MacOS and was a breeze to set up with a wired connection.And there's a major bonus considering the price range: the "starter" toner kit has a page-rating comparable to their regular toner purchase.Canon supports a number of MacOS versions for this printer (included some EOL ones like "Mountain Lion"). I downloaded drivers from the Canon website-- the recent date on them indicates they're still actively maintained. This was for my older system running MacOS Sierra; it's quite possible newer MacOS already bundles the drivers. Once you have the drivers and the printer is on the network, it's literally 3-4 clicks to add the printer, select the type, and set it as the default. No other software needed.This model has a "alternate" feed right above the main tray, for printing envelopes, labels, etc. Note the slightly cheaper monochrome ImageCLASS does not have this feature.The printer is really fast coming out of sleep mode and generating that first print. Faster than the massive office-style HP Pagewide it replaces.In fact, my only quibbles are very minor:* it's a little loud when powered on / plugged in* the paper tray doesn't hold a full ream* it looks sort of cheapBut considering how inexpensive it is, all of these things are completely acceptable.I'll also note, for most printing, B&W is just fine, and color is much much more expensive (whether laser toner or ink). If you don't specifically need to print color, I highly recommend sticking to monochrome. If you've ever bought a set of color cartridges (or toners) when all you usually do is print black&white, you'll know exactly what I mean.I first came to know Canon as a camera company, but have since come to appreciate their printers, of which I've owned several. This is my first Canon laser, and I'm pleased with it. Highly Recommended.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 16 October 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Lightning fast printer, abysmal wireless support
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I just want to start off by saying I am fairly tech savvy. Unboxing and setting up the physical aspects of the printer itself was an easy task. However, problems arise by getting this thing to turn wireless.I just have to ask, why was this not created with a Bluetooth feature for set up? My printer that was from the early 2010s wireless was set up via Bluetooth! It was a piece of crap all around, but at least it had easy set up! Instead you are tasked with this bizarre linking set up to your internet connection. Currently, I am unable to actually use the wireless feature. I was able to find my wireless connection and even enter my password, yet this machine is claiming it can't find my internet! The software it uses looks like it hasn't been updated since the early 00s. Canon even has an installation app that is user friendly...why was this device omitted from using it? As of now, I am giving up on the wireless component of this device. I am glad I got it at a discount otherwise it would be returned as I am using half of the devices capabilities.On the bright side, setting things up the non-wireless mode is a piece of cake. I have a desktop computer and I just have left it connected nearby. I just plugged it into the motherboard of my PC and it was good to go (the USB's in the back, not the USB at the top or front). My computer was able to find the device and set it up on its own. I was able to also set this up non-wireless on my macbook laptop as well.Anyway, apart from my attempts and failures at using the wireless feature this printer works pretty great. I've never owned a quicker printer than this one by a long shot. For reference I've owned HP, Brother, and Epson. I timed it out of curiosity and it takes me about 2 seconds to print a full text page, 3 seconds to do a double sided page.All in all, I actually rate this printer 4 stars due to the speed and quality of the printer. I work in research and I am often printing out extremely long files and this thing does it in 1/4 of the time my other printers did. The wireless feature is a shame, perhaps I will get it to work one day. If I do, I will update this review with any tips I learned.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: STOP RESEARCHING THIS PRINTER IMMEDIATELY! DO NOT ADD TO CART! RUN
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Save yourself the misery and do not get a Canon printer. I should've known better because I recently had to setup my mother's more expensive Canon printer and that was a nightmare. Ended up having to buy a special cable that doesn't come with the printer and the instructions are so horrible that it took hours to figure out what the issue was.But anyways on to this monstrosity.1. Installation was a nightmare. I wasted hours of my life that I will never get back. The instructions for set up are just pictures. I was trying to set up via usb and windows just wouldn't recognize the printer. My PC is not bluetooth enabled so I didn't have any other options for installation. Watched youtube videos, spoke to customer service and just kept getting errors. Eventually was able to get it to print after countless times of trying & retrying the same thing.2. Wireless printing would not work for any of my Apple devices. Had to download the Canon business app and then go to the website through the app just to print a page. Not convenient and just a waste of time. I have a HP inkjet that I can easily print things from wireless devices.3. So every other printer I have ever had has an icon for windows on the desktop. Whenever I just try to do a normal print I get errors at least twice and then on the third try it will go through and then print 3 times.5. The print quality is sad. productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 9 May 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: UPDATE:  After dealing with trying to get this printer connected and eliminating the flashing error light, my husband (who is much more technical than I am) called Canon Support. After over an hour on the phone with a very nice and patient tech, the problem is solved. It seems that there was another orange plastic bit that we couldn't see that was still wedged behind the toner cartridge. Also, there were 3 separate drivers for Linux - and my husband had chosen the wrong one. There was no indication of which one was the right one. The printer now works very well, although I gave it 4 stars due to poor instructions. It prints VERY fast, the saturation is full and dark, and this now promises to fulfill our printing needs.We bought this printer to get away from having to buy expensive color ink. Since we hardly ever print in color, this seemed the best and most logical choice. Canon has a wonderful reputation, however they failed to note that this printer seems to not be compatible with Linux. They say there is a Linux driver, and we did find that and downloaded it, but the "page jam/error" red light is still blinking. It has been blinking ever since we turned it on. Having never been able to print, it can't be a paper jam. Besides, we looked very, very carefully in all the hidden places of the printer just to find nothing loose or wrongfully put in. If we can't resolve this issue within the next few days, we will have to return it.
