productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 4 May 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Versatile and Compact Little Powerhouse of a Printer, But Not Without Limits.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This is an easy-to-use "mini printer" that prints anything up to about four inches wide. It comes with one roll of paper that is inside the printer but will need to be installed. At first, I thought it didn't even come with any paper, so make sure you open the printer to check because there is a roll there. I have several other Phomemo printers, so I thought my existing Phomemo app on my phone would find it, but it didn't. I headed to the app store to see if there was another Phomemo app, which there was. After downloading that one I was able to find this printer immediately. It would be nice if you could run all their products from a single app, but I understand that this printer's functionality is substantially different from my other Phomemo printers with are more for printing labels and barcodes.Once the app located the device, I was able to play around with the different options available. There are quite a few things you can do with this, but I'm not sure how useful any of them will be for my particular needs. I thought this would be great for printing photos from my phone, and it does do a decent job of that, although I don't think the paper that came with the machine (transparent adhesive) is the best choice for photo printing since it's transparent. The upside of transparent paper is that you could stick it on colored paper to create a layered effect. I've put pictures of two of the photos I printed from my phone so you can see the quality of the print when using it for that kind of application. As you can see, there are obvious artifacts in the photos, but this isn't a photo printer per se, so this is to be expected. The photos are not archival quality and won't last over the long term, with an average image retention of 10 years, so this is better for something like a picture you want to turn into a sticker and not something you'd put into a scrapbook. There are other papers out there that are compatible with this printer and are more in line with using it for photo printing and even though I haven't tried them yet I would expect some level of improvement in the overall end result.The app that you need to use with this printer doesn't have a steep learning curve and you'll figure it out fairly easily even if you've never used a printer like this before. To make it even easier for users, Phomemo has included a vast array of templates that you can customize to give you inspiration for new ways to use the machine. There are an equal number of graphics that you can use to customize your creations. The downfall of the app for me was that you can't do much customization with the text. If you use a template, there isn't any way to center, bold, underline, adjust line spacing, or font style. You can do this using the "Notes" function, so it seems like it's only limited if you use a template. I did create a "note" using different fonts and other style adjustments, thinking maybe I could copy the note and paste it into the template. You can do that, but it will not preserve the formatting, so that's a bummer. Obviously, it takes a bit of trial and error to sort this stuff out, but that's true of any new device you're trying out for the first time.The largest learning curve for me with printers of this type has been adjusting to the paper sizes which are defined in millimeters instead of in inches. This model accepts paper rolls that measure 53, 80, or 110 millimeters wide, which are roughly equivalent to 2, 3, and 4 inches wide. I did notice that the back of the paper has a sort of watermark - they should use that to indicate the paper size, which I would find infinitely helpful, especially if you use different papers of different sizes and change them regularly. The user's manual included gives some additional advice about what type of papers to use and what the expected image retention is for each type so that you can pick the appropriate type for your particular application. There is quite a range of paper compatible with this printer including different colors and ones that are adhesive and ones that aren't. They're relatively inexpensive depending on how many things you plan to do with this printer.Overall, I like this printer a lot. It's very versatile but I think it's more in the lane of doing craft-type projects or creating things for kids than it is for business and general household tasks. Not that you couldn't use it for all of the above, but the templates and graphics put it more firmly in the creative crafting category for me. I do wish that the app I use with my Phomemo label printer had as many templates and graphics available as this one does! This printer is substantial and has a solid feeling build quality which is on par with all the Phomemo printers I've tried. The company is responsive if you run into any issues or just have questions and the printer has a one-year warranty.

aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
The PT-D600 is a versatile, PC-connectable label printer well suited for a variety of labeling usages in a business environment. 
Create labels using the large library of fonts, frames and symbols. 
Create personalized labels up to 24mm (.94”) wide using virtually any combination of the 14 fonts, 11 font styles, 99 frames and over 600 symbols available to choose from. 
Plus, the PT-D600 features a large internal memory that lets you save up to 99 of your most-commonly used labels and reprint them with a few button presses! 
Get an accurate picture of the label you’re creating. 
The PT-D600 is the first P-touch Label Printer to feature a full-color graphic display. The backlit display updates in real time as you type and format, and it even automatically detects the color of the installed tape, presenting a true WYSIWYG (what you see is what you get) label design experience. 
Print a wide range of professional labels from your Windows or Mac computer. 
P-touch Editor Label Design software enables you to connect to your computer to create an impressive array of labels. Choose from an expansive library of label templates and create custom labels using fonts, symbols and graphics stored on your computer. 
When connected to a computer, the PT-D600 can even print professional labels featuring high-resolution barcodes and logo 
Ideal label printer for business users to quickly create a wide variety of professional, durable labels for their office. 
The P-touch PT-D600 is a compact, PC-connectable label printer with a color backlit graphic display and a large, QWERTY-style keyboard that help make it easy to create professional labels for the office. 
You can connect the PT-D600 to a Windows or Mac computer with the included USB cable to be used with the free P-touch Editor Label Design software1 . Used on its own, the PT-D600 features an easy-type keyboard with large keys and an angled design for comfortable typing. Its fast print speeds and automatic tape cutter make it particularly well-suited for larger labeling jobs.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: OTTIMA STAMPANTE CON GESTIONE MOLTO ECONOMICA
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Le cartucce originali a colori di una stampante costavano tanto e non duravano tanto. Ho pensato di comprare questa stampante solo col nero e ne sono contento. E' molto economica e una cartuccia di toner originale CANON, con una spesa di € 25,00 (comprese le spese spese di spedizione),  ho stampato senza risparmio per oltre un anno e mezzo ( dal 23/01/2023 al 17/06/2024). La consiglio a chi deve stampare molto e vuole risparmiare.

Hatte etwa 5 Jahre lang das weiße Modell, welches ich dann weiterverschenkt habe, als jemand dringend im Homeoffice einen Drucker brauchte. War von dem Modell so begeistert, dass ich es nun nachgekauft habe. Einfach zu installieren, und druckt fehlerfrei und superschnell. Wenn man keinen Schnickschnack braucht, sondern ab und zu Texte drucken will, ohne dass etwas eingetrocknet ist oder plötzlich den Geist aufgibt, obwohl es nur in der Ecke stand - absolute Empfehlung. Und die Laserpatrone hält auch ewig. Musste beim Altgerät nie wechseln, drucke etwa 10 Seiten im Monat.

No preciso wiffi, ni gama superior, ni conexiones/conectores múltiples. Busco fiabilidad mecánica (2014), impresión aceptable de buena calidad en versión monocromo por USB con fácil instalación para imprimir documentos varios a buen precio. Con esta compra de Canón, (Canon i-SENSYS LBP6030B), funcionando y cumpliendo estas expectativas al 100%. Señalar, eso sí, que como en alguna otra marca conocida, no viene con el Cable de Impresora Láser Escáner USB (LBP6030W), necesario para conectar con el ordenador. Yo utilice el de la antigua impresora, pero si no lo tienes puedes comprarlo al mismo tiempo que la impresora por 6 u 8 euros.

Produit léger et peu encombrant. Le but était de partir en vacances avec. Opération réussie. Bonne qualité d'impression laser. Installation du pilote sans problème.Attention, le câble USB n'est pas livré avec, comme déjà mis en commentaire par un autre acheteur.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Convenient and actually prints really well!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I got this printer specifically to avoid having cords and stuff all over the place, and to not have a giant printer taking up valuable real estate on my desk. I wanted it for it's small size, a good print quality (I print my drawings), and to be able to put it on my desk *only* when  I need to use it...It does exactly what I wanted. When I'm not using it, it sits on my side table by my bed charging. When I need it, I unplug it and put it on my desk. No messy cables, no massive size taking up tons of room. And the print quality is actually *really* good for it's size! At first, it looked really bad, especially when printing on photo paper; but then I learned that I actually need to specify the print quality and paper type through my computer. Once I set it to "photo paper" and high quality, it printed my color drawings perfectly and clearly. I haven't tried printing proper photos yet, but I assume they will look pretty decent, as well. The only thing I consider a con, though, is that the ink cartridges are pretty small. I don't print a lot, though, so that's okay to look past. Also, it's pretty expensive! Again, that's okay...worth it now that I'm experiencing what it can do.

A.C.I. PACKAGING Fully Upgraded Handheld Inkjet Printer for Batch Code Date Number Logo Expiry Date Label Plastic Bottle Hand Jet 
The A.C.I. PACKAGING Fully Upgraded Handheld Inkjet Printer is a high-performance thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer designed for batch codes, date numbers, logos, expiry dates, and other critical labeling needs. 
About this item:- 
This printer is particularly suitable for marking on a wide variety of surfaces such as plastic bottles, packaging materials, and other products. 
The printer provides high-definition resolution, ensuring clear and readable prints, even for small details like barcodes or QR codes. This is essential for compliance with industry standards and regulations. 
Equipped with an intuitive digital interface, the printer allows users to easily set up and customize their print content. 
The user-friendly controls make it simple to adjust fonts, sizes, and other parameters. 
This handheld printer can print text, logos, QR codes, barcodes, serial numbers, and dates. It’s equipped to handle various printing needs, making it ideal for small to medium-scale production and packaging tasks.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 29 July 2022
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: OK, I’m no longer a skeptic!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have one of those all-in-one ink jet printers. Great to print documents but not so much for decent images.  Ink is pricey & there is always the hassle of at least one cartridge running out of ink not to mention changing cartridges & getting printer back up to proceed. I needed a fast, easy & inexpensive way to print a bunch of images for court filing. After much research, reading consumer reviews & watching videos, I chose the Canon Selphy CP1300.  Fast Amazon shipping had it in my hands in no time. It is compact but solid. Instructions were pretty straight forward & easy enough to follow.  Had that printer up and running in less time than it takes to cook a pot of grits. I figure if this ol’ 70+ granny can do it then easy peasy for others.Before printing make sure nothing is against back of the printer like the power cord that would impede the paper as it goes back and forth when printing.Quality…Ok, not that of an expensive pigment ink archival large format printer (which I use to own for award winning prints) but a darn good better than most of those cheap ink jets!You are limited to no larger than a 4”x6” print but that meets my needs.The Canon paper/ink bundle includes 10 prepackaged paper, 18 sheets in each pack as that is max number of sheets in the tray at one time. That’s enough paper for 108 4”x6” prints.  There are also 3 ink cartridges, so I’m assuming one cartridge will handle 36 prints. $30 price range is very reasonable for this many prints, especially when compared to using ink jet printers with 4-6 different color cartridges that when one goes empty you can’t proceed until it’s replaced!I don’t know how Canon does it but the prints are not only archival for up to 100 years but they come out smudge and water proof out of the tray!  I managed to get some glue stick residue on front of a couple of prints while affixing to documents. I used a damp tissue and wiped it all off without any damage to the prints!Can’t wait to start printing off those grandbaby pics!Special note:  The printer only comes with 5 sheets and one cartridge that only prints 5 so be sure to order at least one box set of additional Canon paper and ink cartridges!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Amazing print quality and fun for printing your photos
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: We purchased this printer so we could print out our digital photos. I researched it a bit, and after reading reviews and info about it online, this sounded like it would have a better print quality then the instant cameras we were considering buying. We were not disappointed the prints are amazing, even better than photos from old film developing! You can transfer the photos many different ways, via bluetooth for phone photos and some cameras. You can use a memory card or a usb flash drive. It takes a little bit of reading the manual to see how to print the photos, it was set to automatically print the photos with borders (which crops the photos a bit), I have to go into the menu and set it to print with borders, then the photos come out showing all the detail in the photo. The only thing I don't like about the printer is, the little screen is not very clear, and it is hard to preview the photos using it. I chose to look at them on the computer and transfer the ones to print to a usb flash drive. The quality of the prints makes it worth the bother though! You do still have to remember to print your digital photos! Though, I think I still have some old 35 mm film spools that haven't been developed yet! The nice thing is you can choose what you want to print!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 9 September 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Great price point to get into thermals!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have used this and a few that are way more expensive, so here is what I have learned. Thermals are very expensive for quality images. Does this compare to $3000-$6000 thermals? No, it does not. However, for the money you can get into the thermal game with a quality piece of equipment. Even though the more expensive machines give you way more detail and resolution, this will pick up the heat signature just like the expensive ones. I can see the heat on a cell tower a mile away from my front door. Up close the image is amazing. As you get farther away it's not as good, but that's how these things work. The sensitivity is great in an urban environment where there are drastic heat differences, but in the woods the image is faded a bit because the temps are all close except for the heat signature. That will stand out. As long as you understand that this is excellent for its price point you will be happy. If you want $3k performance for $500, you are not gonna find it here. Over all its a great entry level thermal.
Cumple lo que promete.Vas a recibir lo que describe en su anuncio, ni más ni menos.Si es bueno o malo no es el punto. Si lo que anuncian es lo que buscas eso recibirás.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 13 March 2022
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Better quality image than expected - Appears to have great range, too
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: First off, I got this as my "Amazon points treat" that I do every several years saving up cash back on my store card & I buy something crazy that I'd never pay cash for... This ended up costing me about $20 more than the points I'd saved up.Ease of use: The buttons are intuitive however are really hard to press. The unit came charged & I was using without looking at the directions within minutes. I ended up reading directions & the zoom feature is misleading. 2x-8x zoom comes in a single button that ONLY has 3 settings marked 1x, 2x, 4x. Being that it's 2x to start with, after doing the math you can see that you only get 2x, 4x & 8x options.Size: This is double the weight of the Flir and quite chunky; however, the size and weight are relatively nominal anyway. The extra features of the record & pic & long battery life are worth the size.Visibility: I will use this mainly for ratting around the property and with the first use, I got about 4x the shots compared to just using my ATN 4K Pro NV. Scanning with the monocular and then aiming with the NV is a bit clumsy since my pellet gun is heavy and using the trigger sticks means lots of balancing & holding & using right eye for scope & left for thermal. I'll get better at it, but for sitting & ratting, it's a must but there's a lot to juggle.Range. I have about 1/2 a mile of vacant desert behind me lined on the far side with houses. I easily saw people across this distance. Although they look like ghostly blobs when on white hot, I could tell they were people. I even aimed at an airplane in its final approach but was still a couple miles away and it picked up white hot on the plane. The plane's size appeared to be about the size of half a thumb, just for size reference. Will also be using to aid in downed big game and for coyote hunting to scan. I scanned from about 20 feet to a hundred yards or so & bunny rabbits glow bright white pretty vividly. anything past about 50 feet starts to get blobby but knowing what's in the field makes it so you know it's a rabbit, etc.Convenience: Being able to scan and not have to hold up a gun to scan is crucial. Not only is it easier to just scan, a person's coverage area of where to scan increases due to safety aspect of not wanting to point the gun at things that may not be targets. I also used it to look at my house to see where potential leaks are for heat escaping.  Its amazing that there's some warmth in places I didn't suspect.Bottom line is I'm so happy that I finally got some usable thermal that has cool features & does what it says it does. This is my 2nd venture to thermal; first being the SEEK plug in for iPhone that is cool for some stuff close & home inspections; but having the phone screen on out hunting is less than ideal. Hope this helps!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: These work well for species identification out to ~ 200 yards for me (I've not used them beyond that range. They are easy to use, and the black hot, white hot, and color modes are useful. I've also used them to survey electrical panels and equipment for hot spots. The stated battery life is a bit ambitious and the instructions could be much better, but overall they are a good value. I've not used them in inclement weather and cannot attest how rugged they are.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 30 January 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Bought this almost 2 yrs ago as a cheap thermal to scan with. Since then it's been fully drained and recharged at least 30 times. Battery lasts just as long as it did when new.Easy to use. Took very little time to figure out the controls. Focus controls, on/off, and mode settings are all easy to use in the dark without looking. Standby mode is another nice feature.Fog is not your friend. Neither is a bright snowy night. When it gets below about 0 degrees, it's not happy either. All of these will result in a white screen. Keep it warm, and use it on dark, clear nights and you can make out mice at 150 yds or more. Fog or brighter night, and you might see a deer at 40 yds. Giving it 3 stars because of its inability to work in colder temperatures.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription:

    Firstly, I got a one day delivery, but the installation from canon was done only after two days, customer care was lethargic to send a person for installation.Coming on to the installation, the assembly is simple but the connectivity through the canon software and the network is a bit leg on the tigers tail process. However the canon person done it good, I recommend to go for the canon installation and suggest you to not do it yourself as it's a vague process and the instructions aren't that clear and good to follow.Coming to the printer, I would say just go for 3010. The only difference between 3010 and 3012 is just the naming on the box, printer and 2 extra ink bottles. None other than these differs. Both has same specifications and also, the printer utility software you get with the printer too says 3010 utility and not 3012 utility. It connects 3012 though. The printer is good, but the plastic seems not heavy and sturdy, it is good to handle it with care.Coming to the printing, I agree it's a slow printer. The speed of printing varies with the quality you select to the print. But, the print quality is excellent I would say. The best I have ever seen in a small scale home printer. That's for both colour and greyscale (B&W). Colour printing is of wonderful quality and the quality deepens with the paper you use. The more quality paper you use, the more vibrant and excellent the print will be. But, If you have to greyscale (B&W) photocopy (Xerox) a document, I suggest you to scan and save it first and then take the print because direct photocopy like placing the paper, printing it does not give a vibrant, detailed photocopy: the photocopy lacks details and information. However, if you scan and save it and then when taking the print, it is of an Excellent quality. In colour photocopy, though it lacks some details it gives a comparatively good print. On the whole, I suggest you to scan save it first and then print for both greyscale (B&W) and colour.Coming to scanning, the scanner works excellent and does its job good. You can customise your scan settings to get good scannings.Coming to the utility software, the software is excellent, some may feel that it has a confusing UI, but it works fine and is clear. Also, the canon selphy app for Android works well with the printer too.Overall, I definitely suggest you the printer as it is one of the best ink tank printers with good print quality available in the market. Bravo! It has a display. Let me update this about reliability after using the printer more.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Lamy blue isn't terribly popular for some reason...
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I decided to use these cartridges in my Safari just simply because of past issues with converters leaking or oozing when dropped (never a Lamy pen, but I still don't trust them).  I really like the shade of blue, even though a lot of pen experts don't think much of this ink.  I do wish it was at least waterproof when dry but for the most part I just use this ink in my everyday work pen. It's distinctive enough that everyone knows my shade of blue and it dries fast enough that there's little chance of smearing.  1 cartridge lasts me a couple weeks with pretty steady daily writing (not journaling or taking notes; I would imagine these would go fast with heavier writing).Overall pretty pleased and will continue to purchase these for daily use and use my All Star with bulletproof ink for signatures.

Introducting Avant Garde Handheld Portable 12.7mm Thermal Inkjet Printer 
Unleash Your Printing Potential 
Unlock a new level of printing excellence with our 12.7mm thermal inkjet printer. Designed to exceed your expectations, this printer combines advanced technology, compact design, and user-friendly features to deliver outstanding performance for all your printing needs.

Take advantage of its wireless connectivity options, allowing you to print wirelessly from your mobile devices, laptops, or tablets. Convenience has never been this accessible. 
cost-efficiency matters, and our thermal inkjet printer delivers. Not only does it provide exceptional print quality, but it also utilizes separate ink cartridges, reducing ink wastage and saving you money. Experience affordability without compromising on performance.

How do I access the option to print? 
Install "iPrint" APP 
Search and download the "iPrint" APP from the Apple store or Google APP market over mobile phone, tablet, or computer. 
Turn on power 
Press the POWER/SET key on the left side of the Pocket mini printer for more than 3 seconds to turn on the power, and the power LED will be blue. 
Search and link printer over Bluetooth 
Click: My > > My device, Search for Bluetooth device: GBXX-XXXX, Pair with GBXX-XXXX (if the small blue circle on the right appears, it means the pairing is successful). 
Select print template or content 
Select various functions on the APP to print in various ways, For example: Photograph, diary, Temprate, Charactor Recognition, Document,Web pages,Click "Print" in the lower left corner to print. 
How to replace the thermal paper of printer! 
1.Press the latch on the right side of the mini printer，then open the cover. 
2.Replace the thermal paper and pull out a small piece of paper to install the paper correctly. 
3.Close the printer of cover,press the POWER/SET key more than 3S to turn on.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Excelente opción para impresiones láser a color
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: La impresora es muy buena, la calidad de la impresión en el papel de la marca hp es genial, yo uso los papeles hp premium de calibre 24, 28 y 32 y se ve genial la calidad de las letras e imágenes.Yo tengo la impresora en casa para las impresiones de la escuela y/o personales así como para el Home office y la tengo conectada por cable a la red así que puedo mandar imprimir desde cualquier dispositivo conectado al wifi y tarda entre 5-7 segundos en comenzar a imprimir, ósea que súper rápido recibe la información y comienza a imprimir.Tiene la opción de impresión en doble cara pero se puede desactivar según se necesite pero por ejemplo en los papeles hp premium que mencioné anteriormente no se traspasa la imagen/letras y se ve genial la impresión, nítida y como en UHD 😜Se le puede activar la opción para imprimir por/desde correo los documentos ósea que desde donde uno se encuentre, puede mandar por correo (a cierta dirección de email que te da la impresora) un email y cuando lo recibe la impresora lo imprime. Se puede activar también para que escanee (tiene scanner a doble cara también) y lo puede enviar por correo a tu email.En general esta genial la impresora, la calidad “UHD” de las imágenes y la nitidez de las letras. Para los trabajos impresos de la prepa y la universidad resulta genial si se utiliza papel premium ya que se ve muy profesional la impresión y se siente premium al tacto, y al ver el documento se da uno cuenta que es impresión láser de muy buena calidad. Súper recomendada la compra con el proveedor Intercompras ya que me enviaron el producto muy bien empacado, la caja dentro de otra caja para que no se maltratara y me llego en dos dias cuando supuestamente me debería haber llegado en 5-7 días.

Als begeisterter Hobbyfotograf war ich auf der Suche nach einem einfachen und tragbaren Fotodrucker, der meine Lieblingsmomente sofort in greifbare Erinnerungen verwandeln kann. Der HP Sprocket hat mich mit seiner kompakten Größe und seiner intuitiven Bedienung sofort angesprochen.Design und Handhabung:Der HP Sprocket ist wirklich klein und leicht – perfekt für unterwegs! Er passt problemlos in meine Tasche und ist daher immer dabei, wenn ich spontane Schnappschüsse machen möchte. Die Einrichtung war ein Kinderspiel: Einfach die App herunterladen, den Drucker per Bluetooth verbinden und schon konnte es losgehen. Die Bedienung über die App ist intuitiv und bietet viele Möglichkeiten zur Bearbeitung der Fotos.Druckqualität:Trotz seiner geringen Größe liefert der HP Sprocket beeindruckend gute Druckergebnisse. Die Fotos kommen in lebendigen Farben und die Details werden gut wiedergegeben. Natürlich darf man keine professionelle Druckqualität erwarten, aber für den sofortigen Ausdruck von Erinnerungen ist die Qualität mehr als ausreichend.Funktionalität:Ein besonderes Highlight des HP Sprocket ist die Möglichkeit, die Fotos mit verschiedenen Stickern, Rahmen und Filtern direkt in der App zu verschönern. Das macht den Druckprozess nicht nur praktisch, sondern auch spaßig! Die Druckgeschwindigkeit ist ebenfalls zufriedenstellend, sodass ich nicht lange warten muss, bis mein Foto in der Hand ist.Akku und Verbrauchsmaterial:Der Akku des HP Sprocket hält überraschend lange durch – ich konnte damit problemlos mehrere Drucksessions am Stück durchführen, bevor er wieder aufgeladen werden musste. Die Verbrauchsmaterialien, also die Fotopapiere, sind zwar etwas teurer als normales Fotopapier, aber die Bequemlichkeit und die Möglichkeit, sofort drucken zu können, machen das für mich wieder wett.Fazit:Der HP Sprocket hat meine Erwartungen als tragbarer Instant-Fotodrucker voll und ganz erfüllt. Er ist perfekt für alle, die spontan und unkompliziert Erinnerungen festhalten möchten, sei es auf Partys, Reisen oder einfach im Alltag. Die Kombination aus handlichem Design, guter Druckqualität und einfacher Bedienung macht ihn zu einem echten Must-Have für Fotoliebhaber. Ich kann ihn definitiv weiterempfehlen!

This multifunction printer exceeds expectations with its impressive range of features, making it an indispensable tool for our daily operations.One of the standout features is the EcoTank system, which significantly reduces printing costs. The large, refillable ink tanks are a game-changer, eliminating the need for frequent cartridge replacements and resulting in substantial savings over time. The quality of the prints is outstanding, with sharp text and vibrant colors that enhance the professionalism of our documents.The Wi-Fi connectivity is seamless, allowing multiple devices in our office to connect and print effortlessly. This feature, combined with the user-friendly interface, has streamlined our workflow and increased productivity. The automatic duplex printing function is another great addition, saving both time and paper by printing on both sides of the page without any manual intervention.The multifunction capabilities of the L6580 are impressive. It handles printing, scanning, copying, and faxing with ease, providing a comprehensive solution for all our office needs. The 50-sheet Automatic Document Feeder (ADF) is incredibly convenient, speeding up the process of handling multi-page documents.Additionally, the PCL support ensures compatibility with a wide range of business applications, which is essential for our varied printing needs. Overall, the Epson EcoTank L6580 is a reliable, cost-effective, and feature-rich printer that has greatly improved our office efficiency. I highly recommend it to any business looking for a high-quality, multifunction office printer. Five stars, without hesitation!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 7 March 2016
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought the iP-110 printer over the Epson offering primarily because there was plenty of aftermarket ink offerings for the Canon that I could not find for the Epson.  This is my first set of aftermarket ink.  I have used 2 blacks and 1 color so far.  They work perfectly and no leaks.  the black has way more ink than the stock canon ink.  the warning came on for low ink which is obviously based on Canon's own fill capacity.  I have printed about 50 pages of calculus notes and 40 powerpoint slide handout pages since the light came on and the black ink is still printing perfectly.  whereas the stock canon cartridge printed about 10-20 pages of notes after the light came on before there was visible low ink problems on the printout.  I will definitely buy Limeink refills again,  at about $2 a cartridge you really can't beat it.  I suggest just watching your printouts when the low ink warning is displayed.  I think you will get a lot of extra printing per cartridge this way.  I take my IP-110 to college 4 days a week.  with the external battery i pretty much print everything i need for school on this printer.  I also did a nice color print of a periodic table Epson glossy paper and it turned out very well.

Ricoh is renowned worldwide as a quality manufacturer of innovative, functional and cost-effective MFPs. Environmental Friendly

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Best Duplex Printer for a Budget price by RICOH in India !!! Impressive Excellent.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Firstly, I would like to clarify a very Important point :- NEVER EVER Install a New Printer by OWN unless you are a Expert. Take help from RICOH or a computer Expert for installation in Office or Home.PRODUCT REVIEW:-PROS:-After reading some negative reviews, and since the DEAL price was too less than the actual MRP, I was a little hesitant. But took the risk since I have purchased/Used a lot of Laser jet and Inkjet printers. Writing the product review point wise to be very specific:-1. Paper Jam ( as complained by few) : My first paper got struck but I checked that a manual setting on tray was wrong and corrected it. Single and duplex printing is smooth.2. Printing Quality : I printed some Text and photos. Texts are very sharp in 600x600dpi print, it can print upto 1200x1200dpi amazing!. Pixel density of B&W photos is good.3. Installation :- Its very simple but expert should be called for installation, if one is not so confident of installation.4. Weight :- Its quite heavy, but I am used to my office printers which are much more stable and consistent in printing large volumes. Cheap printers sold in market for home users are such a waste of money due to frequent breakdowns. It is even useful for home users at this price point!. Print quality better than inkjet printers.CONS:-1. No wifi :- No problem for personal single computer use. Maximum office networks in India are on LAN so its manageable.2. No MFP:- ALL-IN-ONE CRAZE!!!:- I could not understand this craze among buyers. Its good to have one but If one goes for a good quality Coloured Laserjet All-in-one it would cost >50K. I presently have a Multifunction Coloured Inkjet Printer (Ink Tank Model for economic printing) for Printing Photos upto A4 size and coloured photocopy/docs. I sold my old Laserjet for RICOH SP3510 for best quality document printing. Total Inkjet MFP + RICOH = 10K + 4K = 14K !!! WOW SAVINGS!!! :). Refills & Inks for Inkjet-MFP(Inktank) & Laserjet are DAMN CHEAP!!!SELLER:-Excellent Seller. Delivery of an item of this size and weight so smoothly to door step is an amazing thing which I an impressed by the seller.  Normal delivery time for a bulky item takes at least 10-15 days, but it was delivered in 2 days hassle free. No Damage No problems. Thanks a Lot!Only complain from the seller is that the picture of the printer is not correct as per description and model number. The Printer is having only one tray and not two as shown in the photo. I request the seller to upload the correct Image

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: MRP is really obsolete. Don't buy if sold for more than 4-5k
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The MRP is obsolete. Official MRP of this product is 20k+, which is not reasonable at all, given the fact that it doesn't even have wifi support, which every generic and cheap printer has these days. I'd suggest you to go for this only if it is sold for around 4k. More than that it is not a worthy purchase, you'll be better off buying a newly launched printer at MRP.On the other hand, if you need it strictly for office use, where large volume of documents is printed on a daily basis, then this might be a worthwhile purchase, because it is a laser printer and does support wired network printing, and is specifically built for printing out large volumes. For home use it does not seem to be a very good choice. Another thing to note, it is a monochrome printer, so no color printing.Hope this helped.
